1: // Simple Space Debris Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Load sound effects (provide your own audio files in the same directory)
7:   const thrustSound = new Audio('thrust.mp3');
8:   thrustSound.loop = true;
9:   const explosionSound = new Audio('explosion.mp3');
10:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
13:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
14: 
15:   // ----- Player -----
16:   const player = {
17:     thrusting: false,
18:     x: width / 2,
19:     y: height - 40,
20:     size: 20,
21:     angle: 0, // radians
22:     speed: 0,
23:     maxSpeed: 4,
24:     thrust: 0.1,
25:     friction: 0.98,
26:     draw() {
27:       ctx.save();
28:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
29:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
30:       // ship body
31:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
32:       ctx.beginPath();
33:       ctx.moveTo(0, -this.size / 2);
34:       ctx.lineTo(this.size / 2, this.size / 2);
35:       ctx.lineTo(-this.size / 2, this.size / 2);
36:       ctx.closePath();
37:       ctx.fill();
38:       // thrust flame
39:       if (this.thrusting) {
40:         ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
41:         ctx.beginPath();
42:         ctx.moveTo(0, this.size / 2);
43:         ctx.lineTo(this.size / 4, this.size / 2 + this.size);
44:         ctx.lineTo(-this.size / 4, this.size / 2 + this.size);
45:         ctx.closePath();
46:         ctx.fill();
47:       }
48:       ctx.restore();
49:     },
50:     update() {
51:       this.x += Math.cos(this.angle) * this.speed;
52:       this.y += Math.sin(this.angle) * this.speed;
53:       this.speed *= this.friction;
54:       // Keep inside canvas
55:       if (this.x < 0) this.x = width;
56:       if (this.x > width) this.x = 0;
57:       if (this.y < 0) this.y = height;
58:       if (this.y > height) this.y = 0;
59:     }
60:   };
61: 
62:   // ----- Stars -----
63:   const stars = [];
64:   const starCount = 100;
65:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
66:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
67:   }
68: 
69:   function drawStars() {
70:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
71:     stars.forEach(s => {
72:       ctx.beginPath();
73:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
74:       ctx.fill();
75:     });
76:   }
77: 
78:   // ----- Asteroids -----
79:   const asteroids = [];
80:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
81:   let lastSpawn = 0;
82: 
83:   function spawnAsteroid() {
84:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 25;
85:     const x = Math.random() * width;
86:     const y = -size;
87:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
88:     asteroids.push({ x, y, size, speed });
89:   }
90: 
91:   function updateAsteroids(dt) {
92:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const a = asteroids[i];
94:       a.y += a.speed;
95:       if (a.y - a.size > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
96:     }
97:   }
98: 
99:   function drawAsteroids() {
100:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
101:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.size * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.size);
102:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
103:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
104:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
105:       ctx.beginPath();
106:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
107:       ctx.fill();
108:     });
109:   }
110: 
111:   // ----- Input -----
112:   const keys = {};
113:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
114:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
115: 
116:   function handleInput() {
117:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.angle -= 0.07;
118:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.angle += 0.07;
119:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) {
120:       player.speed = Math.min(player.maxSpeed, player.speed + player.thrust);
121:       player.thrusting = true;
122:     } else {
123:       player.thrusting = false;
124:     }
125:     // Manage thrust sound
126:     if (player.thrusting) {
127:       if (thrustSound.paused) thrustSound.play();
128:     } else {
129:       thrustSound.pause();
130:       thrustSound.currentTime = 0;
131:     }
132:   }
133:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.angle -= 0.07;
134:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.angle += 0.07;
135:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) {
136:       player.speed = Math.min(player.maxSpeed, player.speed + player.thrust);
137:       player.thrusting = true;
138:     } else {
139:       player.thrusting = false;
140:     }
141:   }
142: 
143:   // ----- Collision -----
144:   function checkCollision() {
145:     for (const a of asteroids) {
146:       const dx = a.x - player.x;
147:       const dy = a.y - player.y;
148:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
149:       if (dist < a.size + player.size / 2) return true;
150:     }
151:     return false;
152:   }
153: 
154:   // ----- Game Loop -----
155:   let lastTime = performance.now();
156:   let running = true;
157:   let score = 0;
158: 
159:   function loop(now) {
160:     const dt = now - lastTime;
161:     lastTime = now;
162: 
163:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
164:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
165: 
166:     // spawn
167:     if (now - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
168:       spawnAsteroid();
169:       lastSpawn = now;
170:     }
171: 
172:     handleInput();
173:     player.update();
174:     updateAsteroids(dt);
175:     player.draw();
176:     drawAsteroids();
177: 
178:     // score
179:     score += dt * 0.01;
180:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
181:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
182:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
183: 
184:     if (checkCollision()) {
185:       running = false;
186:       // Play explosion sound
187:       explosionSound.play();
188:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
189:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
190:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 80, height / 2);
191:       return;
192:     }
193: 
194:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
195:   }
196: 
197:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
198: })();
